description: The most recent saved quotes in the current buying context, each with its status as the Quotes list shows it, total (with delivery, as the Quotes list shows it), expiry and link. Read only. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.
name: list_quotes

shipping_ex_gst.description: Delivery ex GST; 0 for pickup, null when no address has priced it.

subtotal_inc_gst.description: The lines' total inc GST, before delivery.

total_inc_gst.description: The quote page's Total, inc GST: subtotal_inc_gst (the lines) plus delivery (shipping_ex_gst) and its GST.

title: List saved quotes
